name: redteam
description: Repeatable, multi-agent, black-box adversarial testing of any authorized target — a network, host, web app, cloud tenant, or bespoke system. An interactive intake derives the target and its authorized scope; the engagement then follows NIST SP 800-115 with MITRE ATT&CK + NIST SP 800-53/53A mapping, standards-grounded test catalogs (OWASP WSTG/ASVS, CIS, OSSTMM), a human approval gate, and evidence capture. Dry-run by default; live probes are gated behind scope enforcement and a human-written approval token.
